focus: Fidelity validation, protected spans, exact-original fallback, evaluation methods

label: Reference has no deterministic fidelity validator; prompt-only preservation
Protected-span classes specified: code, paths, commands, flags, variables, URLs, hashes, identifiers, quotes, names, numbers
Encoding strategy: opaque placeholder substitution before inference, decode+validate after
Objective rejection gates required: zero changed/missing/duplicated/reordered protected spans; structure intact
Fallback contract: fail to exact original, at most one bounded notice per session
Deterministic gates must be automatic machine gates (SC-003)
Semantic gates (new fact/polarity/requirement strength) need human adjudication; SARI/LENS regression-only
Evaluation corpus: versioned secret-free corpus with 6-CLI event fixtures
Blind rubric: meaning, plainness, fluency, indistinguishability; >=3 runs per provider/model/prompt
Operational metrics: p50/p95 first-token/full latency, fallback rate, token use, cost, privacy class
Pipeline-owner runtimes make display swap naturally atomic; removes process-death blank-screen risk
